author: Totally Not Mark
description: Dragon Ball Super Beerus is jumping straight into Resurrection F in episode 7. It's filled with some very interesting decisions and some much improved visuals. But did it cut too much? Did it cut the right scenes? Here's my two cents as we explore the episode that revives Freeza while Goku and Vegeta continue their training with Whis and Beerus.
title: Did Toei Just SAVE Resurrection F?
